svg.title: One coupling step of the three-dimensional ocean
svg.desc: One step of the three-dimensional ocean: physics_ocean3d_advance() first fills the latitude ghost rows of all levels of T, S, u, v and w from the neighbouring ranks; deep_ocean_step() then resets the top layer to the slab SST with freshwater dilution, evaluates the linear equation of state and hydrostatic pressure, diagnoses the geostrophic velocity with an Ekman drift in the top layer and the vertical velocity from continuity (capped at plus or minus 1e-6 m/s at every level), applies sub-cycled upwind advection and explicit diffusion of temperature and salinity, mixes adjacent layers where the lower one is lighter by more than 1e-4 kg/m3 and both have positive salinity (repeated until nothing mixes, at most as many passes as layers), and finally returns the deep-ocean heat flux to the slab; the ghost rows are refreshed after the top-layer reset, after the velocity diagnosis and after each tracer sub-step.
